event: Danantara published its first consolidated financial statements, for April-December 2025, at a press conference in Jakarta, reporting net profit of Rp203.4 trillion for nine months (Rp259.6 trillion annualized). (update of E1098)
key_numbers: Net profit Rp203.4 T (Apr-Dec 2025), Rp259.6 T annualized · Revenue Rp2,385.2 T (9 months), Rp3,073 T annualized · Total assets Rp11,607 T (+5.0%) · Equity Rp2,980 T (+5.6%) · ROE 8.7% (annualized) · EBITDA Rp552.5 T (9 months) · Dividends received Rp143 T, ~Rp11 T paid to the state · BPK opinion WTP (per Liputan6)

event: The IHSG closed down 0.84% on 25 November amid rupiah weakness, with foreign investors net selling about Rp336 billion. (update of E1095)
key_numbers: IHSG 5,197.61 (-43.97 pts, -0.84%) · Intraday low ~5,174 (-1.3%) at 15:15 WIB · Foreign net sell Rp336.22 B (BBRI Rp217.9 B, TLKM ~Rp131-133 B) · Foreign net buy BBCA Rp323 B, BMRI Rp134.6 B · Value Rp7.10 T, volume 20.71 B shares (Kontan) · LQ45 542.86 (-0.60%) · 43.1% below 20 Jan 2026 high of 9,134.70

event: The rupiah weakened to about Rp18,332 per US dollar on 25 November, a new weakest level, as dollar strength, Fed hike bets and domestic politics weighed. (update of E1096)
key_numbers: Rp18,332/USD close, -102 pts (-0.56%) per Disway; Journalarta says Rp18,303 (+0.67% USD/IDR), unclear if close or intraday · Previous record close Rp18,268 (16 Nov, Bisnis/Kontan) · 24 Nov close Rp18,230 · Cited drivers: Fed hike expectations for December, US PCE data due Wed night, MSCI review (decision by 30 Jun 2027), Middle East tensions, VP succession politics

event: Polri's ethics panel (KKEP) of five three-star generals led by Komjen Hendro Pandowo is set to hear ex-Kapolri Listyo Sigit Prabowo at 09.00 WIB on Thursday 26 November over the alleged illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo. (update of E1105)
key_numbers: 26 Nov 09.00 WIB · 5 panel members (all Komjen) · panel chair Komjen Hendro Pandowo · 4 officers already dismissed (Ahrie Sonta, Eko Hadi Santoso, Tedjo Kusumo, AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra)

event: Bareskrim named a civilian identified only as NE a suspect in the illegal wiretapping case, alleging NE carried out orders from ex-Dirkrimum Polda Metro Jaya Kombes Iman Imanuddin to create hoaxes from a 'posko makar' in Cibinong, Bogor. (update of E1087)
key_numbers: Wiretapping case: 5 suspects (Listyo Sigit, Slamet Uliandi, Eko Hadi Santoso, Ahrie Sonta Nasution, NE) · makar case: 6 suspects (adds Iman Imanuddin, Brigjen Tedjo Kusumo) · max penalty 20 years or death

event: After Prabowo nominated Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono to replace VP Gibran, parties split in their reactions: Demokrat supports, Golkar calls both worthy, PKB and PDIP hold back or question the picks, and DPD says it will consult Prabowo before the vote. (update of E1088)
key_numbers: 2 candidates (Amran Sulaiman, Sugiono) · letter delivered 23 Nov before 23.59 deadline · MPR vote about 2 weeks away (plenary set 9 Dec) · DPD 18 members on ad hoc committee/verification team

event: President Prabowo met DPR Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad one-on-one at the Palace for about two hours, with the Setkab saying Dasco passed on public aspirations and reports received by the DPR.
key_numbers: ~2 hours · 24 Nov afternoon · same day Prabowo ordered quick follow-up of ~USD 15 billion Shenzhen investment deals

event: Polri and Philippine police named 139 Indonesians suspects in an online scam run from KE Towers in Pasay City, Manila, targeting victims in Indonesia; Komdigi minister Meutya Hafid and Kapolri Suyudi Ario Seto spoke at Soekarno-Hatta airport.
key_numbers: 139 WNI suspects (one video headline says 141) · up to 15 years prison · charges: fraud, data manipulation, TPPU

event: KPK seized apartment-rental income owned by a suspect in the Papua Provincial Government operational-funds corruption case, which KPK puts at Rp1.2 trillion in state loss, while pursuing sub-treasurer Deus Enumbi.
key_numbers: Rp1.2 trillion state loss · ~Rp1 trillion annual allocation under a governor's regulation · amount seized not disclosed · Lukas Enembe died 26 Dec 2023

event: Depok immigration refused a passport to a man identified as DA after finding Telegram chats about joining Russia as a mercenary; he said he saw the recruitment ad on TikTok and cited economic hardship, and Polda Metro Jaya is investigating other parties. (update of E1121)
key_numbers: Claimed offer: USD 50,000 signing · USD 3,000-6,000 monthly · USD 167,000 to family if killed · USD 100 per recruit · applied 18 Nov, questioned 23 Nov

event: Komdigi Minister Meutya Hafid said at a press conference that Komdigi has handled 67,578 online fraud contents and received public reports via AduanNomor.id, CekRekening.id and AduanKonten.id. (update of E1113)
key_numbers: 67,578 fraud contents handled · 103,940 phone-number reports on AduanNomor.id (15,292 scamming, 17,631 impersonation, 19,422 extortion) · 196,624 bank-account reports on CekRekening.id · operators must block flagged numbers within 1x24 hours of a Komdigi request · Permenkomdigi 7/2026 requires biometric SIM registration

event: CNBC Indonesia, citing the New York Times, reported that Alice Huang, an executive at Nvidia customer Megaspeed International, allegedly stayed in contact with a Chinese intelligence official while involved with Jensen Huang; this is unconfirmed. (update of E1112)
key_numbers: contact reportedly spring 2025 to autumn 2026 (over a year) · Megaspeed is a major Nvidia customer worth billions of dollars in chip sales · Megaspeed blacklisted over suspected chip smuggling to China · detikInet terpopuler #1 and #3 on Huang topics

event: CNBC Indonesia, citing Reuters and Counterpoint, reported Xiaomi's Q3 2026 adjusted profit fell 57% as memory chip costs hit phones and global smartphone shipments dropped 20%.
key_numbers: adjusted net profit 4.9bn yuan (~Rp13.4tn), -57% YoY · revenue 107.2bn yuan, -5.2% · phone gross margin 9.2% vs 11.1% · Xiaomi shipments -30%+, share 12% · global shipments -20% YoY, lowest Q3 since 2012 · phone makers raised prices ~20% on average in 2026 · Xiaomi EV deliveries 100,975, -7.2%

event: Huawei's Richard Yu said HarmonyOS has passed 100 million installations, and Counterpoint data show it as number two in China ahead of iOS.
key_numbers: 100m+ installs · 460,000+ apps · 12m+ developers · China share Q2 2026: Android 58%, HarmonyOS 24%, iOS 18% · global: Android 75%, iOS 20%, HarmonyOS 5% · global rollout over 1-3 years

event: CNBC Indonesia reported China's Moore Threads is preparing a Lushan gaming GPU reportedly with 64GB VRAM, while Nvidia's RTX 5090 sells at over three times its MSRP.
key_numbers: Lushan up to 64GB VRAM (unofficial) · RTX 5090 32GB, US$6,599 at Newegg, 3x+ MSRP · launch expected before end 2026

event: Katadata reported that Samsung Securities in South Korea was hacked, leaking data of 8,241 customers including account numbers and addresses.
key_numbers: 8,241 customers · account numbers, addresses and contact details exposed

event: Katadata reported a Jakarta trader was paid Rp10,000 to train an AI robot and warned of personal data risk.
key_numbers: Rp10,000 per task · housewives paid to train AI (CNBC Indonesia, 24 Nov)

event: Flash flooding on 23-24 November trapped dozens of illegal gold miners (gurandil) in two pits at Gunung Butak, Nanggung, Bogor; Basarnas-led search teams had recovered 9 bodies by the evening of 25 November.
key_numbers: 9 dead (6 from Pit A, 3 from Pit B) · 17 still trapped (CNN Indonesia 20:30; detik photo-news gives the same 9/17) · earlier count 7 dead, 19 missing at 18:44 · 26 families reported missing relatives at the DVI post · pits about 100 m deep (bodies found at 40-70 m) · rain from about 18:00 on Monday, river surge about 23:00

event: BKN said the SSCASN portal is open and about 1.47 million PPPK contract workers can apply for CPNS civil-servant selection in 2026-2027, without their PPPK status automatically blocking them.
key_numbers: 1.47 million eligible PPPK of about 3.3 million · 278,241 SSCASN accounts created so far · about 3 million applicants expected (about 20 per slot) · process about 181 days, CPNS NIP targeted by 1 June 2027 · 3,995 CAT devices, about 15,980 participants per day · portal opened 17 Nov

event: DKI Jakarta's transport agency fired a Mikrotrans JAK 10A driver for refusing to let a passenger with a disability sit in a priority seat.
key_numbers: detik most-read #10 on 25 Nov snapshot · no fine or compensation figures reported in the sources read

event: Falling trees in bad weather killed people in at least two places: a man electrocuted while helping clear a fallen tree in Pekalongan and a motorcyclist hit by a tree in Musi Rawas, South Sumatra.
key_numbers: detik most-read #5 (Pekalongan) and #7 (Musi Rawas) on 25 Nov snapshot · 1 death each per headline
sources: detik terpopuler <https://www.detik.com/terpopuler> ; Kompas Bandung (weather in Kab. Bandung) <https://bandung.kompas.com/read/2026/11/25/074034178/kabupaten-bandung-dilanda-banjir-dan-pohon-tumbang-bmkg-keluarkan-peringatan>

event: A fire at a Pertamina fuel station (SPBU) in Kramat Jati, East Jakarta, started from a car being refilled, briefly reached the dispenser and canopy, and operations were halted.
key_numbers: reported by CNBC Indonesia, ANTARA Banten and others on 25 Nov · no casualty figure confirmed in the snippets read

event: Police dog units were deployed to search for victims at the Cikande, Serang factory fire, per ANTARA. (update of E1054)
key_numbers: no new casualty figure read
